findings.highlight: The last of my seminars also ended today.
findings.evidenceJa: 今日はこのままゼミの打ち上げ
findings.explanation: Haruki says he is going straight on to the seminar wrap party today, while the fourth-years and M2 students still have no holiday. The English says only that his last seminars ended, deleting the party that structures the chapter's parallel meetings.
findings.japanese:
『今日はこのままゼミの打ち上げ。
とは言っても四年やＭ２の先輩たちには、
クリスマスも正月もないんだろうけど』
findings.todokanai: "The last of my seminars also ended today. Even so, our upperclassmen from fourth year and M2 still don't get to enjoy Christmas or New Year's."

findings.highlight: skiing in Hokkaido or Okinawa
findings.evidenceJa: 北海道でスキーとか、逆に沖縄とか
findings.explanation: Haruki proposes skiing in Hokkaido or, conversely, going to Okinawa. The English grammatically makes both Hokkaido and Okinawa skiing destinations, erasing the deliberate warm-versus-cold travel contrast and creating the false Okinawa activity.
findings.japanese:
『雪菜は冬休み、どこか行く？
北海道でスキーとか、逆に沖縄とか。
それとも思い切って海外？』
findings.todokanai: "Where are you planning to go during winter break, Setsuna? Are you going skiing in Hokkaido or Okinawa? Maybe going overseas?"

findings.highlight: I can't walk right back out after coming in here.
findings.evidenceJa: お店に入ってすぐに出てきても駄目
findings.explanation: Setsuna says a parfait should not come out immediately after entering the warm shop; it should arrive after her body has warmed. The English says Setsuna herself cannot leave immediately, changing the timing of the dessert into the timing of her departure.
findings.japanese:
「ん～、やっぱりおいし。
お店に入ってすぐに出てきても駄目なんだよね。
だいぶ体があったまった頃に出てきてもらわないと」
findings.todokanai: "Mmm～ but this is so delicious! I can't walk right back out after coming in here. I have to let my body warm up first before I leave."

findings.highlight: if you know anyone that suits me, please introduce them to me
findings.evidenceJa: 手当たり次第コナかけてる
findings.explanation: Chiaki claims she is indiscriminately flirting with every available prospect to find a man by Christmas. The English instead asks Setsuna to introduce a suitable person, replacing active scattershot seduction with passive matchmaking.
findings.japanese:
「あたしはさぁ、もう大変よぉ。
クリスマス合わせで新しい男見つけようって、
手当たり次第コナかけてるんだけどさぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Well, I'm just doing terrible here. I'd like to find a new man during the Christmas holidays, so if you know anyone that suits me, please introduce them to me."

findings.highlight: She never attended any of the seminars, even when her papers were due, but Izumi suddenly decided to attend the party all of a sudden, forcing me to make all sorts of adjustments.
findings.evidenceJa:
今までゼミの行事を、課題提出含め全部スルーしてきた
和泉が、初めて打ち上げに参加してもいいってんで、
結構方々に調整で走り回ったんだけどなぁ。
findings.explanation: Chiaki skipped seminar events, including assignment submission, while the English says she never attended seminars even when papers were due.
findings.japanese:
今までゼミの行事を、課題提出含め全部スルーしてきた
和泉が、初めて打ち上げに参加してもいいってんで、
結構方々に調整で走り回ったんだけどなぁ。
findings.todokanai: She never attended any of the seminars, even when her papers were due, but Izumi suddenly decided to attend the party all of a sudden, forcing me to make all sorts of adjustments.

findings.highlight: …As bad as I may feel about saying this, it seems that I'm the only one capable of taming her.
findings.evidenceJa:
...言い方は悪いけど、
俺にだけは懐いてくれてると思ったんだけどな。
findings.explanation: Haruki thought Chiaki had become tame or attached only toward him; the English asserts he alone is capable of taming her.
findings.japanese:
...言い方は悪いけど、
俺にだけは懐いてくれてると思ったんだけどな。
findings.todokanai: …As bad as I may feel about saying this, it seems that I'm the only one capable of taming her.

findings.highlight: your imagination is way too rich
findings.evidenceJa: 逆だよ...感受性が豊かだったんだ
findings.explanation: Setsuna answers that the opposite was true: he was richly sensitive, which is why neither wound heals. The English tells Chiaki that her imagination is rich, assigning the quality to the wrong person and severing the causal link to Haruki's lasting guilt.
findings.japanese: 「逆だよ...感受性が豊かだったんだ」
findings.todokanai: "It's the opposite… and your imagination is way too rich."

findings.highlight: I got into a little trouble
findings.evidenceJa: ちょっと中てられてた、というか、ものすごく濃い特訓してた
findings.explanation: Chiaki says she was overwhelmed or affected by Setsuna and, more precisely, underwent an extraordinarily intense training session in studying her. The English calls this getting into trouble and learning a hard lesson, losing both her intoxication by Setsuna and her actress-observer metaphor.
findings.japanese:
「...ごめん。
ちょっと中てられてた、というか、
ものすごく濃い特訓してた」
findings.todokanai: "…I'm sorry. I got into a little trouble… Well, specifically, I learned a pretty hard lesson."

findings.highlight: There's no way our relationship wouldn't be shaken by words like that.
findings.evidenceJa: 別に、そんな言葉に動揺するような関係じゃない
findings.explanation: Haruki insists theirs is not the kind of relationship in which “I want to be alone with you” should unsettle him. The English says there is no way it would not unsettle their relationship, reversing the denial that his subsequent agitation exposes.
findings.japanese:
『二人きりになりたい』って...
別に、そんな言葉に動揺するような関係じゃない。
findings.todokanai: "The two of us, alone," huh… There's no way our relationship wouldn't be shaken by words like that.

findings.highlight: You haven't spoken to the professor for a while
findings.evidenceJa: 教授とだって、まともに話したことない
findings.explanation: Haruki says Chiaki has never properly spoken with the professor. The English says only that she has not done so for a while, inventing a prior working relationship and weakening his argument that she finally needs to appear.
findings.japanese:
「教授とだって、まともに話したことないだろ？
あと一年以上付き合うんだからさ、
そろそろ顔出しといた方がいいんじゃないか？」
findings.todokanai: "You haven't spoken to the professor for a while either, right? You still have to bear with him for another year, so shouldn't you at least show up?"

findings.highlight: incapable of finding a retort
findings.evidenceJa: 和泉のその決断を、引き留めることなんかできない
findings.explanation: Because his motive is guilty, Haruki cannot ask Chiaki not to go home or hold her back. The English says he cannot find a verbal retort, replacing a relinquished attempt to keep her with argumentative defeat.
findings.japanese:
そんな後ろめたい理由だからこそ、
和泉のその決断を、引き留めることなんかできない。
findings.todokanai: It's because I'm feeling this guilt that I'm incapable of finding a retort against Izumi's decision.

findings.highlight: Despite having put aside the gloomy atmosphere
findings.evidenceJa: なんとなく湿っぽい雰囲気に後ろ髪を引かれつつ
findings.explanation: The damp emotional atmosphere makes both characters reluctant to part, so they keep holding the silent phones to their ears. The English says they have put that atmosphere aside, reversing the feeling that physically prolongs the ended conversation.
findings.japanese:
なんとなく湿っぽい雰囲気に後ろ髪を引かれつつ、
俺たちは、会話の終わった受話器を耳に当て続け...
findings.todokanai: Despite having put aside the gloomy atmosphere between us somehow, we continue holding our phones to our ears despite having ended our conversation.

findings.highlight: I just want to enjoy myself
findings.evidenceJa: 楽に、なりたいだけなの
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she no longer wants to keep striving; she only wants relief, to be released from the burden. The English makes this a wish to enjoy herself, trivializing the exhaustion that immediately makes Haruki ask who denied her any ease.
findings.japanese:
『ただ、もう頑張りたくないだけ。
楽に、なりたいだけなの』
findings.todokanai: "It's just that I don't want to work so hard anymore. I just want to enjoy myself, that's all."

findings.highlight: a woman who's above my own league
findings.evidenceJa: あれと同等以上の女を演じなきゃならない
findings.explanation: Chiaki says she now has to perform a woman equal or superior to “that”—Setsuna as the model she has just intensely studied—for the demanding Haruki. The English makes the woman above Chiaki's league, obscuring the acting task and its specific comparator.
findings.japanese:
「あれと同等以上の女を演じなきゃならないなんて、
なんてハードルの高い男だろうねぇ、春希くん」
findings.todokanai: "Making me act like a woman who's above my own league… You're setting the bar awfully high, Haruki-kun."

findings.highlight: Izumi is complaining as she continues drinking
findings.evidenceJa: 和泉は飲んで騒ぐだけ
findings.explanation: Haruki describes their standard unfair gathering: he makes snacks and prepares drinks while Chiaki only drinks and makes merry or noise. The English says she is complaining and that he sponsors the food, changing both her action and his hands-on caretaking.
findings.japanese:
俺がつまみを作り、酒を用意して、
和泉は飲んで騒ぐだけの、不公平な宴席。
findings.todokanai: An unfair drinking party where Izumi is complaining as she continues drinking despite me being the one who's sponsoring all the snacks and drinks.

findings.highlight: an area far to the north
findings.evidenceJa: 北陸地方の民話
findings.explanation: The paper concerns folklore from the named Hokuriku region. The English replaces Hokuriku with a generic area “far to the north,” geographically mislocating or de-specifying the research topic and breaking the earlier correct rendering of the same phrase.
findings.japanese:
北陸地方の民話なんていう、
かなり資料を探すのも大変そうな、
しかも地味な研究をしていた学生時代。
findings.todokanai: It was about a folktale from an area far to the north. Just looking for information on that kind of subject is extremely difficult, and it's also a very uncommon theme for a student to work on.

findings.highlight: slow-witted
findings.evidenceJa: 怠惰で要領良くて人間として軽い和泉
findings.explanation: Haruki calls present Chiaki lazy, efficient or adept at getting by, and frivolous. The English calls her slow-witted, reversing 要領が良い and making his question about when her savvy lightness formed into doubt that she could write the paper.
findings.japanese:
今の、怠惰で要領良くて人間として軽い和泉は、
いつ形づくられたんだろうって、
失礼な疑問が頭に浮かぶのは当然だと思う。
findings.todokanai: It's only natural for me to rudely wonder how someone as lazy and slow-witted as Izumi would ever be able to complete such a paper.

findings.highlight: Her grip is stronger than it usually is
findings.evidenceJa: いつもの力強さ...って言うか、俺の照れと躊躇を誘発しないための気遣いがない
findings.explanation: This touch lacks Chiaki's usual forcefulness—the rough play that normally spares Haruki embarrassment by keeping contact unserious. The English says her grip is stronger, reversing the tactile change that makes the gentle contact more intimate.
findings.japanese:
いつもの力強さ...って言うか、
俺の照れと躊躇を誘発しないための気遣いがない。
findings.todokanai: Her grip is stronger than it usually is… perhaps she's just not bothering to make sure I'm not embarrassed or hesitant this time.

findings.highlight: both the liquor and the hot sweat are rushing out of my body
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は、酒だけじゃない、熱い汗を噴き出させ
findings.explanation: Overcome by Chiaki's unexpected sensuality, Haruki breaks into hot sweat caused by more than alcohol alone. The English says liquor itself rushes out of his body alongside sweat, producing impossible physiology and obscuring arousal as the additional cause.
findings.japanese:
そんな、和泉とは思えない『色』にあてられて、
俺は、酒だけじゃない、熱い汗を噴き出させ...
findings.todokanai: I never thought this kind of "seductiveness" would be coming from Izumi, both the liquor and the hot sweat are rushing out of my body…

findings.highlight: I can't resist my reflexive answers to her questions.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分に反動が返ってくることは避けようがない
findings.explanation: Even if Haruki keeps his heart hidden, he cannot avoid the emotional backlash rebounding onto himself. The English turns this into an inability to resist reflexive verbal answers, changing the cost of concealment from inward pain to conversational impulsiveness.
findings.japanese:
心の中をいくら隠し通しても、
自分に反動が返ってくることは避けようがない。
findings.todokanai: No matter how hard I try to hide my feelings within my heart, I can't resist my reflexive answers to her questions.

findings.highlight: heading toward Aikawa
findings.evidenceJa: 有川行き
findings.explanation: The destination is Arikawa: the same corpus renders 有川 as “Arikawa” and the related school name 東有川 as “Higashi-Arikawa.” “Aikawa” is a local inconsistent reading of the place name in the station announcement.
findings.japanese:
「６番線、有川行きが参ります。
ご注意ください」
findings.todokanai: "Your attention please. The train on Line 6 heading toward Aikawa will arrive shortly."
